hant.text: 我 （名字） 今世和前七世所造的一切一切業
（兒女債，錢債，人情債，怨情債，夫妻債，情債，六親眷屬債和一切眾生債）。
我今祈求懺悔今世和前七世所做的一切一切，
真心祈求原諒，對不起，對不起，對不起，
我把我所做的功德迴向給你們，謝謝。
早晚各三次或七次，對鏡而念，看著自己，真誠發心。
此偈可幫助安定心念，化解雜亂與不順。
持之以恆，短期內可見改善。

simp.text: 我 （名字） 今世和前七世所造的一切一切业
（儿女债，钱债，人情债，怨情债，夫妻债，情债，六亲眷属债和一切众生债）。
我今祈求忏悔今世和前七世所做的一切一切，
真心祈求原谅，对不起，对不起，对不起，
我把我所做的功德回向给你们，谢谢。
早晚各三次或七次，对镜而念，看着自己，真诚发心。
此偈可帮助安定心念，化解杂乱与不顺。
持之以恒，短期内可见改善。

en.text: I, (your full name),
sincerely repent for all the karma I have created in this life and in the past seven lifetimes.
To all karmic creditors, including:
debts with my children,
financial debts,
debts of human relations and obligations,
emotional grievances and resentments,
debts between spouses,
debts of love and relationships,
debts with relatives and family members,
and debts with all sentient beings.
I now sincerely repent for everything I have done.
I truly ask for your forgiveness.
I am sorry, I am sorry, I am sorry.
I dedicate all the merits I have accumulated to you.
Thank you.
(How to practice)
Recite with your heart and mind.
Morning and night, 3 or 7 times. Face a mirror, look at yourself, and speak with sincerity.
This practice helps calm the mind and resolve inner disturbance and misfortune.
With consistent practice, improvement can be felt in a short time.
